title: Sum of Even Numbers After Queries
summary: Given an integer array nums and queries, for each query update nums[indexi] by adding vali, then calculate and print the sum of all even numbers in nums.
statement: Given an integer array nums and queries, for each query update nums[indexi] by adding vali, then calculate and print the sum of all even numbers in nums. Return an array of sums corresponding to each query.
constraints: Each query [value,index] adds value to nums[index].
After each query return the sum of all current even values.
reference_solution:
def even_sums_after_queries(nums, queries):
 total=sum(x for x in nums if x%2==0);answer=[]
 for value,index in queries:
  if nums[index]%2==0:total-=nums[index]
  nums[index]+=value
  if nums[index]%2==0:total+=nums[index]
  answer.append(total)
 return answer

hints: Only the queried position can change the even sum.
Remove its old contribution when even, mutate it, then add its new contribution when even.
Append the running total after every query.
All untouched values retain parity and value, so their contribution never needs recomputation.
